observation.visible_scene: A person wearing a face mask, brown jacket, and blue gloves stands in a grassy area bordered by a wooden fence and dense trees. They hold two wands connected by a loop of string, from which a massive, iridescent soap bubble is suspended.
visible_changes: The giant bubble expands and drifts towards the right side of the frame.
The string loop detaches from the left edge of the bubble and hangs down from the wands.
The person walks slowly to the left, lowering their arms slightly as the bubble floats away.
The bubble continues to float rightward, displaying shifting rainbow colors on its surface.
outside_clip_unknowns: The process used to generate the bubble film before the clip started.
Whether the bubble bursts or lands after leaving the frame.
uncertain_details: The precise moment the string loop fully separates from the bubble film.
